name: content-creation-suite
description: 面向自媒体、内容创作者与市场运营的全流程内容创作工具箱，覆盖选题发现→爆款拆解→知识沉淀→风格学习→图文创作→视频编导→口播脚本→图片生成→智能排版→跨平台发布的完整创作链路。
descriptionEn: An end-to-end content creation toolkit that covers the full lifecycle: topic discovery, breakdown of viral content, knowledge accumulation, style learning, writing, video directing, video scripting, image generation, layout optimization and cross-platform publishing.
